title: Get help now
intro: You're not alone. These are free, private, and many have Spanish speakers. A trusted adult — a parent, teacher, coach, or your school counselor — can help too.
urgent: If you are in danger right now, call 911.
counselorHelp: Add your counselor's name and how to reach them in Me → Profile, so it's always here.
trustedAdult: Talking to a trusted adult is a strong move, not a weak one.
